name: Open-Faced Hot Turkey or Roast Beef Manhattan
whyItWorks: Soft white or potato bread topped with warm deli turkey, mashed peeled potatoes, and smooth bone-broth gravy - eats with a fork with zero tough crusts.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Layer potato bread, warm sliced turkey breast, and mashed potatoes, then ladle warm savory bone-broth gravy over the top so the bread softens completely.
